sources.title: Fine-tuning Guide | QwenLM/Qwen | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This guide explains how to fine-tune Qwen models to adapt them for specific tasks and domains. It covers the different fine-tuning approaches, data preparation, performance considerations, and working with fine-tuned models.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 Fine-tuning Guide | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B can now be fine-tuned and trained with reinforcement learning (RL) via Unsloth. It is a dense 27B unified vision-language model with native text, image and video support, thinking controls and a 262K context window.
